name: Makalot Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Makalot Industrial Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of garments for men, women, and children in Taiwan. It offers fashion clothing; sports clothing; sleepwear, including long and short pants, T-shirts, dresses, shirts, inner pajamas, sports suits, jackets, etc.; and ready-to-wear clothing, active wear, loungewear, and gift sets. The company also provides material development, supplier search and management, style design, fashion trend provision, manufacturing, research and development, and logistics and distribution services. It also exports its products to the United States and internationally. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.
